verdict.rationale: ScrapingBee offers premium_proxy and country_code parameters and an 'auto' mode that picks the cheapest configuration that succeeds, implying some automatic fallback/retry logic, but there's no explicit documentation of a chained multi-proxy retry mechanism specifically triggered by anti-bot detection. missing for 10: explicit documentation of automatic retry chains across multiple proxies upon anti-bot block detection, and independent verification of this retry behavior.
